name: Kokoro Smart TTS Skill
purpose: Transforms Kokoro TTS into expressive, human-like speech via intelligent text preprocessing, calibrated breath pauses, and multi-voice tensor blending.
capabilities: Intelligent text normalization (currencies, numbers, multipliers, fractions, initialisms)
Punctuation prosody enhancement (em-dashes, unicode ellipses, breath commas)
Calibrated genre presets (conversational, documentary, storytelling, energetic, technical-explainer)
Exact millisecond timeline marker generation for animation sync

installation.instructions: Built-in workspace skill. No installation needed.

compatibility.notes: Tested with Kokoro 0.9.4 and Python 3.12 on Apple Silicon M2.

security.notes: Preprocesses text and synthesizes local WAV files via Kokoro.

approval_evidence: Evaluated with before/after audio benchmark across 3 genres in examples/before_after_samples/.
